summary: Writes two 16-bit values (a3, a4) into the list entry at index a2 of a linked list owned by `this`. Reads the list length via ShortComputation_adb0 (which reads this+0xC). If the index equals the length the entry is appended by delegating to ObjectConstructor_adc0(this, a3, a4). Otherwise, after an out-of-range guard that nulls the walk pointer at this+0x8, the code walks the node chain from this+0x0 using the next-pointer field at node+0x4 down to index a2, then writes a3 and a4 to the selected entry's two 16-bit data slots, returning 1 on success and 0 when the walk or the entry payload is null. Called from sub_493060 (0x00493060).

operations.description: Reads the list length with ShortComputation_adb0(this), which reads this+0xC
When a2 equals the returned length the function appends: delegates to ObjectConstructor_adc0(this, a3, a4) and returns its result
When a2 is negative or not below the capacity this+0xC, the walk pointer this+0x8 is set to null
Initializes the walk pointer this+0x8 from the list head this+0x0
When a2 is positive, walks the node chain, repeatedly reading the next-pointer field at node+0x4 and decrementing the remaining count until the target index is reached or the chain ends
Returns 0 when the selected node pointer this+0x8 is null or when the node's payload pointer is null
Writes a3 to the entry's first 16-bit data slot and a4 to the second, then returns 1 on success
